description.value: Wild 1 Cookhouse is a Thai and Asian outdoor cookhouse on Galiano Island, one of the Southern Gulf Islands and a popular cycling destination. It operates entirely outdoors — there is no indoor seating — giving it a casual, open-air character well suited to the island's relaxed atmosphere. For cyclists exploring Galiano, it represents one of the few dining options on the island.
